The run alone, above, passed 5 of 5. Not a defect of the change.

My first forged-cookie attempt overwrote the MAC's second-to-last character with uppercase 'A' and was accepted (302). I did not log that character; the likely cause is that it was 'a', since Go's hex.DecodeString reads uppercase hex and 'A' then gives the same MAC bytes, which is no forgery. The corrected forgeries above (a different hex digit, a changed payload) are refused.
